title: Vikram and Betal: The Helpful Child
moral: Kindness and honesty make a person great.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a helpful child.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a child who helped others.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The child sees someone in need.
scenes.text: The child saw an old woman struggling with a basket.
scenes.image_prompt: child helping old woman carry basket cartoon

scenes.text: The old woman blessed the child for his kindness.
The child found a lost purse and decided to return it.
scenes.image_prompt: child finding purse on road cartoon

scenes.text: The owner rewarded the child. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: child returning purse and being rewarded cartoon

story: A helpful child showed kindness and honesty by helping others and returning lost money. Vikram said these qualities make a person great.
